print.title: Printing instructions
print.step1: Print at actual size / 100 % scale. Turn off “Fit to page”, “Fit to printable area” or “Shrink oversized pages”. Do not use the viewer's “Poster” mode.
print.step3: Print the assembly page first and measure the test square: it must measure 50 mm (or 2 in). If not, check step 1 or calibrate the printer.

overlap.title: Assembly with overlap
overlap.step1: Arrange the sheets following the assembly page (A1 at the top left).
overlap.step2: On each sheet, trim the margin along the dashed line on the left and top edges (except in the first column and the first row).
overlap.step3: Join each row from left to right: place each sheet over the right strip of the previous one, aligning its edge with the alignment line (▶), and glue.
overlap.step4: Join the rows from top to bottom in the same way, over the bottom strip.

butt.title: Butt-joint assembly
butt.text: Trim all interior edges along the dashed line and bring the sheets together so that the half diamonds match. Tape them from behind.

help.title: Help
help.intro: How to print at actual size, assemble the sheets and answers to common questions.

print100.title: Printing at 100 %
print100.intro: If the viewer shrinks the sheets to fit, the result will not line up. Always look for the actual-size option.

chrome.name: Google Chrome
chrome.text: In the print dialog open “More settings” and under “Scale” choose “Default” (100 %). Do not tick “Fit to printable area”.

edge.name: Microsoft Edge
edge.text: Under “More settings” set “Scale” to 100 % and turn off “Fit to page”.

firefox.name: Firefox
firefox.text: Under “Scale” choose “Custom” with 100 %, not “Shrink to fit”.

acrobat.name: Adobe Acrobat Reader
acrobat.text: Under “Page Sizing & Handling” choose “Actual size”. Do not use “Fit” or “Shrink oversized pages”.

preview.name: Preview (macOS)
preview.text: In the print dialog show the details and set “Scale” to 100 %; untick “Scale to fit”.

scale.q: The test square does not measure 50 mm
scale.a: It is almost always because the viewer fitted the page. Print again at actual size. If it persists, the printer has its own scale error.

blank.a: Sheets with no content are not printed to save paper. You can change the sensitivity or turn it off under “Tiling”.

raster.q: My image comes out at a strange size
raster.a: Images without a reliable resolution get an assumed size. Tell us what size they represent from the warning in the editor.

units.title: Units
units.hint: Everything is calculated internally in millimetres.

storage.title: Storage
storage.text: Documents and results are deleted automatically after {{hours}} h.
storage.confirmText: All documents and jobs will be removed, including those that have not expired. This cannot be undone.
storage.retentionLocked: The retention is fixed by the server configuration (A0TD_RETENTION_HOURS) and cannot be changed here.

printers.title: Printers
printers.intro: Printer profiles define margins per paper, colour and calibration. Built-in profiles are read-only; duplicate one to adapt it.

defaults.title: Region defaults
defaults.hint: Chosen from your browser region (Letter and in in US/CA, Letter and mm in Latin America, A4 and mm elsewhere). You can change them.

form.name: Name
form.readonly: Built-in profiles cannot be edited: saving creates your own copy.

form.capsRead: Read {{count}} known paper size(s) from the printer. Accepts: {{pdf}}.
form.capsNoPdf: PWG Raster only (it will be converted)

cal.title: Calibrate "{{name}}"
cal.printHelp: Print it at 100 % (actual size), with "Fit to page" turned off, on the selected paper. Then measure the rulers with an accurate ruler and read the margin frames.
cal.marginsHelp: For each side enter the margin of the first frame that appears complete (the frame labels give its distance in mm).
cal.outOfRange: The correction is outside {{min}}–{{max}}: you probably printed with "Fit to page". Print at 100 % and measure again. Nothing is saved.
cal.saved: Calibration saved. Margins stored: {{top}} / {{right}} / {{bottom}} / {{left}} mm (measured + 0.5 mm). Correction {{kx}} × {{ky}}.
cal.builtinBlocked: Built-in profiles cannot be calibrated. Duplicate it first.

tokenMode.title: Browser access is disabled
tokenMode.body: This server uses token authentication (A0TD_AUTH_MODE=token), which is meant for the API and the command line only. The web app cannot be used in this mode.
tokenMode.hint: Use the REST API with an Authorization: Bearer header, or ask the administrator to enable password authentication for the web interface.

presetsPage.title: Presets
presetsPage.intro: Built-in presets are read-only. Create your own from the settings of the document you were last editing, then rename, export or share them as JSON files.
